# Sample Project

A minimal TypeScript fixture used by the mcp-toolbelt end-to-end scenario
tests. Not shipped, not published.

## Layout

- `src/index.ts` — a couple of exported functions using zod.
- `src/index.test.ts` — a trivial smoke test.

## Scripts

- `pnpm test` — runs the trivial smoke test.
- `pnpm typecheck` — runs `tsc --noEmit`.
- `pnpm lint` — echo stub.
